_: THE SHOP'S PALETTES, AS DATA. The seller changes these often, so they are not spelled out in the stylesheet any more - build_db.py writes the chosen one into site/src/styles/theme.css and global.css imports it. Changing the whole shop is one word in business.config.json: "theme". Add a preset by copying a block; every preset must define every token, because there is no fallback and a missing one is an invisible colour.
_plate_wall: The background of the large image panels ONLY. Every mockup is photographed on flat cream, rgb(237,234,227). Set it to that exact value on a light theme and the photograph has no edge; on a dark theme set it near the page colour so the print reads as a lit panel on a dark wall, which is how a gallery actually hangs work.
_scheme: light or dark. It sets color-scheme, so native form controls and scrollbars follow the palette instead of fighting it.

ink-black.label: Ink black - black page, white type

paper-white.label: Paper white - white page, black type

gallery-cream.label: Gallery cream - the mockups' own background, no seam

plaster-pink.label: Plaster pink - warm gallery pink, claret accent
